name: zinc finger and BTB domain containing 7A

function.text: ZBTB7A encodes zinc finger and BTB domain-containing protein 7A. Annotated molecular activities include DNA-binding transcription factor activity and DNA-binding transcription factor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific. It participates in DNA-templated transcription and chromatin organization.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to macrocephaly, neurodevelopmental delay, lymphoid hyperplasia, and persistent fetal hemoglobin (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; strong GenCC assertion from Labcorp Genetics (formerly Invitae). Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
